transcript.content: Hello. I'm Dr. Smith. To get us started, could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Um... well, I guess I'm here because I keep getting up when I'm supposed to just... stay put. It happens during client interviews, or tutoring sessions... even at my book club. People are just starting to notice that I can't really sit and listen. So... yeah. That's mainly it.
Looking back at your time in elementary school, did you have similar trouble sitting still or staying in your seat in class?

Um... yeah, I suppose I did. My old grade-school report cards usually said I was bright, but... that I couldn't stay in my seat. Or wait my turn. My mother actually still jokes about it. She says I treated every classroom like a crime scene I had to pace through. So... yes.
Aside from the trouble sitting still, do you find that you frequently make careless mistakes or have trouble paying attention to details in your work?
Um... no, not really. I don't think I make careless mistakes. I... I'm pretty good at catching the details, actually. It's just the sitting still part that's the issue.
Do you find that you often talk excessively, even when you are in situations where you should be quiet?

Um... yeah, I guess so. I... I do talk a lot. Sometimes I catch myself just... talking through every angle of a case, or, you know, a client meeting. I'll just keep going until I've basically filled all the air in the room. Even when... um... even when the other person is giving me clear signs that they're done listening. So, yes.
Do you often feel a sense of internal restlessness, like you are constantly being driven by a motor?

Um... I suppose so. Even on days when I don't have any field work, I... I don't really stop. I just move from unpacking boxes to... reorganizing old case files, or running errands. It's almost like I'm still chasing a lead somewhere. I just... have a hard time really being off duty. So, yes.
Do you often find that you have difficulty sustaining your focus on tasks or activities, even if you are interested in them?
Um... no. I don't think so. If I'm working on something, I... I can stay with it just fine. I don't really lose my focus.
